Deposit $10000 into a Pangolins vault on Base and keep the shares. Cost: $10000 of capital and about $8 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Reallocate part of the vault deposit into a second Pangolins vault with a different risk profile. Cost: about $4 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.

Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, and spread it across Base and Binance when the protocol runs on both. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $10000 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 5 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Exit when the protocol's TVL falls below 70% of today's $5,729,047 or the drop window closes; unwind in reverse order, starting with the last action you took. Exit gas is not modelled — check the chain's own fees when you unwind. Cost: no fee to check; exit gas not modelled. Time: 5 minutes.
